_note: Corrections layered over upstream's mc_config.json. Every field is optional; absent means keep upstream. Makers key on the maker slug, devices on the exact device name. Icon and image paths resolve against this file. Run scripts/check-catalogue-overrides.py after editing.
_fields: name    | makers  | display name, overrides upstream's
icon    | makers  | logo; upstream ships none, so absent means the chip glyph
label   | devices | display name; the flow still keys on upstream's device name
image   | devices | artwork, overrides the picture upstream hides in its tooltip
filter  | both    | invert | white | black — works with or without our own image
dim     | both    | false exempts the art from the 0.5 dimming stock tiles get
plate   | both    | false drops the tile gradient and border behind the art
hidden  | devices | true drops the device from the catalogue entirely
filter: white is brightness(0) invert(1), so it flattens the whole image —
good for a logo with transparency, wrong for a photo with a light backdrop.
